title: 3-Day Yogurt Shawarma Prep
ingredients: Marinade: 1 cup 0% Greek Yogurt, 2 tbsp Lemon Juice, 1 tbsp Cumin, 1 tsp each (Coriander, Turmeric, Garlic Powder, Salt), ½ tsp each (Cinnamon, Smoked Paprika, Black Pepper).
Prep: Coat chicken; refrigerate in airtight container up to 3 days.
Side Option 1: The "High-Volume" Cabbage & Chickpea (No Feta/Cucumber/Tomato)
Base: 2 bags Coleslaw mix (cabbage/carrots) + 2 cans Chickpeas (rinsed) + 2 Red Bell Peppers (sliced).
Dressing: Renee’s Mediterranean Greek (~2 tbsp per serving).
Method: Toss 1/3 daily with cold chicken or top with hot chicken. Massive crunch, high fiber.
Side Option 2: The "Classic" Feta & Chickpea Salad
Base: 2 English Cucumbers (cubed) + 3 Roma Tomatoes (cubed) + 2 cans Chickpeas (rinsed) + ½ cup Crumbled Feta.
Dressing: Renee’s Mediterranean Greek (~2 tbsp per serving).
Method: Keep cucumbers/tomatoes separate; toss with chickpeas and dressing just before serving to prevent sogginess.
instructions: Cook: Sear 1/3 daily in non-stick pan (medium-high) 4–5 mins per side until charred.
Serve with tzatziki made from Greek yogurt
